tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje rin po che'i rnam thar dang 'brel ba'i rtogs brjod kyi

'grel pa dgongs pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me bzhugs/ na mo swa ra swa t+yai/ bgrang yas gdod ma'i bskal bar thugs bskyed tshogs gnyis sa bon nyer bskrun las/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i yal ga'i khyon rdzogs mkhyen brtse'i me tog rnam par bkra/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu'i khur gyis rab brjid phan bde'i dri bsung 'phro ba can/ /thub dbang dpag bsam ljon pa che de lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs/ /rgyal kun yab gyur spangs rtogs mthar son kyang*/ rgyal sras sa bcu'i dbang phyug zlos gar gyis/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa mtha' dag sgrub brtson pa/ /rgyal sras thu bo 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /gang des ral pa'i zur phud rgyan dor nas/ /ngur smrig gar rol thub bstan yongs kyi bdag /mkhas shing grub pa'i rtser son thams cad mkhyen/ / rgyal ba gnyis pa grags pa de la 'dud/ /mgon khyod nges pa'i don du sangs rgyas kyang*/ /drang don zhing 'dir sems dpa'i tshul bzung nas/ /thos bsam sgom mdzad rmad byung rtogs brjod kyi/ /tshig don cung zad rnam par dbye bar bya/ /de yang rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo bdag cag gi bla ma rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po de nyid kyis byang sems slob pa'i tshul gyis/ sku tshe 'dir thos sogs ji ltar mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod rje rang nyid kyis dgos pa chen po gzigs nas mdzad pa 'di nyid kyi dgongs don 'grel par byed pa la gnyis/ rnam thar thun mong ba mtshon tsam spyir bstan pa dang*/ 'chad bya gzhung don bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la rje 'di'i rnam thar thun mong ma yin pa ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul du grags pa 'di nyid yin la/ tshul bstan gyi rnam thar thun mong ma yin pa ni mkhas grub rjes mdzad pa la sogs pa ltar ro/ /phyi ma ltar na sku tshe 'dir thos bsam sgom pa'i tshul ji ltar mdzad pa dang*/

yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi zhal gzigs pa dang*/ rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa mthon po brnyes pa sogs ni bsngags brjod kyi gnas khyad par can yin kyang*/ dang po ltar na 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i sangs rgyas dngos yin pa'i phyir bsngags brjod de tsam mi che ste/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos rje'i bstod par/ /'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen rol par nges rnyed nas/ /khyod blo ri dwags dka' gnad sgrog gi rgyar/ /bcings rnams zur phud lnga pa'i gsung mtshon gyis/ /bcad la tshar du 'dzin pa byis pa'i blo/ /rnam 'brel sras bcas grangs med tshogs rnams dang*/ /lhan cig gsang gsum bkod pas dus 'da' na/ /'phags mchog paṇa grub 'ga' zung gzigs zhes pa'i/ /bstod bsngags mgon 'di'i che ba'i 'os su min/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dbang po mngon grub pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spro bsdur mnga' 'byor na/ /lhag pa'i lha 'gas byin gyis brlabs so zhes/ /bsngags brjod dar dir sgrog la re ba bskyungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang mkhas grub chos rjes rje 'di nyid nges don du bskal ba grangs med pa'i sngon rol nas sa bcu rdzogs pa'i 'phags chen zhig tu bzhed de/ / des mdzad pa'i rnam mthar chen mo las/ /bdag nyid chen po mtshan brjod par dka' ba 'di ni/ /bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas sa bcu yongs su rdzogs par mdzad de/ ma dag pa'i zhing khams rnams su yang la lar ni 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*/ la lar ni khams kyi rgyal po dang*/ 'ga' zhig tu ni brgya byin dang tshangs pa'i gzugs dang*/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba'i tshul la sogs pa gdul bya dang 'tsham pa'i sku'i rnam par 'phrul pa dpag tu med pa ji ltar nam mkha'i lam las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig nyid kyis sa'i steng du chu snod tha dad pa sna tshogs pa zhig gi nang du cig car rang gi gzugs brnyan ston pa de bzhin du 'bad rtsol med par nye bar bstan pa las/

bdag cag rnams la ni 'u bu rang dang 'gro ba ris mthun par skye ba bzhes pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid kyi rnam par bstan pas don mdzad do zhes bya bar khong du chud par bya ba yin pa gor ma chag ste/ /'di la bdag nyid yid ches par bya ba'i lo rgyus kyi gtan tshigs gtam du gleng ba'ang thos so/ /de lta mod kyi tshul de ni skye bo phal mo che dag gis bsam par bya dka' ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bdag cag dad pa dang bsam pa'i stobs dman pa dag gi rang bzhin dang skal pa ji lta bu yin pa nye bar gzigs pa'i dbang gis bdag nyid kyang don 'di zhal gyis 'ches par mi mdzad pa'i phyir gnas 'di ni bsnyad par bgyi bar mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar na'ang sku tshe 'dir mdzad pa ji ltar bstan pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa ni mkhas grub chos rjes mdzad pa dang*/ bsdus don btsong kha brgyad cu dang*/ gsang ba'i rnam thar sogs nas 'byung ba ltar yin la/ skabs 'dir mtshon tsam zhig brjod na/ 'khrungs pa'i yul dus ni/ ji skad du/ sprul sku'i 'khrungs yul gangs can shar gyi phyogs/ mdo smad btsong khar me mo bya lo la/ /klu 'bum dge dang shing bza' a chos kyi/ /sras su bsams bzhin 'khrungs pa'i btsong kha pa/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar te/ rje 'khrungs pa'i lo nas da lta'i lcags bya 'di'i bar lo sum brgya dang gya lnga song la/ sku gshegs nas sum brgya nyer gnyis song ngo*/ /de yang me yos drug pa'i nang gi lo so gcig thog tu 'khrungs nas/ bdun pa'i so gsum thog tu gshegs pa ste/ da lta'i lcags mo bya 'di me yos bcu gnyis pa'i lo zhe lnga pa yin no/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sgyu 'phrul mngal gyi chu 'dzin las/ /rgyal sras don kun grub pa bzhin/ /rigs ldan yum gyi chu gter las/ /rgyal sras zla ba gnyis pa 'khrungs/ /sngon tshe sngon gyi sras gtsang sras po bzhin/ /snyigs dus snyigs ma'i 'gro la brtser dgongs pa'i/

/rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi myu gu zhig /sa steng sa phyogs de ru gsar du 'khrungs/ /yang na thugs bskyed dri bzhon gyis/ /rgyal sras nam mkha'i nor bu zhig /'gro 'di'i blo mun sel ba'i ched/ /tshogs gnyis shar re'i rtse nas drangs/ /'khrungs nas lo gsum pa'i dus su karmā ba rol pa'i rdo rje'i drung du yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos shing mtshan kun dga' snying po zhes bya bar gsol/ dgongs lo bdun pa'i dus su chos rje don grub rin chen dang*/ gzhon nu'i byang chub ces pa rnam gnyis kyi drung du rab byung mdzad de/ klog yig sogs la sbyangs pas thog med du mkhyen/ lo lnga drug nas bcu drug gi bar chos rje bsten nas dpang lung man ngag du ma dang*/ bde mchog lha lnga dang*/ kyai rdor sogs yi dam 'ga' re'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa mdzad/ /rab tu byung ba nas rmi lam du gsang bdag gtum po dang*/ /jo bo rje rnam gnyis kyi sku'i rnam pa yang yang gzigs te/ de ni mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i bdag por 'gyur bar byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ / 'dam skyes pad+mo 'dam gyis ma gos bzhin/ /mi rtag srid 'byor snying po med gzigs nas/ rgyal sras gzhon nus khyim pas sdom bzung ste/ ring por mi thogs tshangs spyod dka' thub blangs/ /chung chung byis pa'i tshul bstan nas/ /mang mang yi ge klog sogs la/ /yang yang gzigs tshe 'bad med par/ /nges nges khyod kyi thugs su chud/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas yongs 'dzin dam pa'i mgon/ /mgon du bsten nas man ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ rgyun du gsol zhing bsnyen sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe/ /tshe 'dir thub bstan bdag por 'gyur byin brlabs/ /bcu bdun lon pa'i tshe mkhan po'i gsung bzhin dbus su byon nas 'bri khung spyan lnga chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du zab 'khrid 'ga' re gsan/ de'i tshe grogs 'ga' zhig gis 'khrid nas gung thang du gso ba rig pa la sbyangs/

de nas ra ba bstod dang sa skya sogs nas mtshan nyid theg pa la sbyangs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ bde ba can dang dpal ldan sa skya sogs/ /bshad grwa 'ga' ru legs par thugs sbyangs nas/ /dbus gtsang gnyis su bka' bzhi'i grwa skor mdzad/ /zla med mkhas par grags pa'i tsong kha pa/ /zhes so/ /'di'i dka' bzhi ni 'dul mngon phar phyin tshad ma bzhi yin par mngon te/ de dus dbu ma'i grwa skor mdzad pa dar mi che'o/ /'o na rje 'dis dka' bcu dang rab 'byams pa'i mtshan gdags mi mdzad pa ci yin zhe na/ de'i tshe dka' bcu dang rab 'byams pa'i mtshan gdags mdzad pa'i srol ma tshugs pa'i dbang gis yin te/ dka' bcu dang rab 'byams pa'i tha snyad ni rje'i sku'i tshe smad du byung bas so/ /rgyal sras nyi ma dbang phyogs na mchis pa/ /sngon bsags bsod nams dri bzhon gyis bskul te/ /chu lha'i phyogs kyi thub bstan pad+mo'i tshal/ /legs par 'byed phyir gegs med byon de rmad/ /sku na na tshod phra mo nas/ /rab mkhas mkhas pa mang bsten te/ /gsungs rab rab 'byams la sbyangs pas/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen rab dbang phyug gyur/ /'dul ba'i gzhung la sbyangs pa'i tshe nyi ma rer 'dul ba rgya cher 'grel mda' tshad ma'i sho gu bcu bdun tsam re 'chags med du blo la 'dzin cing*/ skabs skabs su mdo'i zhal 'don mdzad pa'i tshe ting 'dzin khyad par can rtsol med du 'khrungs/ phar phyin gsan sbyong mdzad skabs mngon rtog rgyan gyi dgongs 'grel legs bshad gser 'phreng zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen mo mdzad/ 'di rje sku na gzhon pa'i dus su mdzad pas phyis su dpyad pa rdzogs nas mdzad pa dang cung mi 'dra yang tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs shing rgya bod kyi mkhas pa du ma'i 'chad tshul la 'gag sgrub dang bcas pa mkhas pa kun yid 'phrog par byed pa zhig ste/ stag tshang lo tsā bas sngar/ rje'i gsung la dgag pa 'ga' re mdzad kyang*/ phyis su gser 'phreng 'di mjal nas gzigs pas dgyes te/

khyod blo nyi mas gzhon nu'i dus nyid na/ /mdo dang rgyan gyi pad tshal rgyas mthong nas/ /bdag blo khengs pa'i kun mud da gzod zum/ /zab yang mkhyen brtse'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes bstod pa phul lo/ /sher phyin gyi mdo'i dngos bstan stong nyid gtso bor ston pa'i dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa mdzad pa'i skabs su/ stong nyid bcu drug gi 'gres rkang gser gyi mdog lta bus nam mkha'i khams gang bar gzigs pa'i yum gyi mdo'i zab don thams cad thugs su chud/ mdor na gzhon dus su'ang rgya bod kyi dbu tshad phar phyin 'dul mngon sogs la phyogs ris med par sbyangs nas rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' dag la mkhas pas mthar son nas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i don mdzad do/ /'phags pa'i yul du ma byon zhing*/ /'phags yul mkhas pa ma bsten kyang*/ /'phags pa yab sras la sogs pa'i/ /'phags bod mkhas pa'i dgongs don gzigs/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod rin chen gser/ /gcig bsdus khyod kyi mkhyen rab yid bzhin nor/ /gzhung don 'byed pa'i srang la gzhal gyur na/ /do mnyam 'on kyang khyod blo lci snyam sems/ /dgung lo sum cur nye ba na mkhan chen tshul khrims rin cen sogs kyi drung du bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'dul ba'i bslab bya mtha' dag srung zhing*/ smon 'jug byang chub tu sems bskyed nas spyod pa phyin drug dang bsdu bzhi sogs la legs par slob/ sngags lam du zhugs nas dbang gi dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung bar mdzad nas 'chad par 'gyur pa ltar rgyud sde rnam gzhi lag len dang bcas pa la thos bsam bsgoms gsum mdzad do/ /rnam dag nges 'byung bser bus rab bskyod pa'i/ /bsnyen rdzogs bsdom rgyun zla mdzes gtsug bsten pas/ /thub bstan kun+da'i tshal rnams cig car du/ /bzhad mdzad sngon med lha chen khyod min su/ /byams dang snying rje'i sa bon las/

/byang chub sems kyi ljon shing 'khrungs/ phyin drug spyod pa'i yal 'dab can/ /sngon med dpag bsam ljon pa khyod/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /dam tshig sdom pa mig 'bras bzhin srung zhing*/ /rgyud don kun mkhyen lag len bcas pa la/ /mkhas pa'i mthar son rdo rje 'dzin pa'ang khyod/ /'jam dbyangs kyi zhal ma gzigs pa'i sngon du dbu ma pas lo tsā mdzad nas dbu ma'i lta ba sogs shin tu rtogs dka' ba'i gnad mang po zhus nas the tshom bcad/ phyis dga' ba gdong du rje btsun bsgrubs pas zhal mngon gsum du gzigs/ phyin chad 'dod kyi tshe gsol ba btab na mthong zhes gsungs pa ltar zhal bstan nas the tshom zhus te bcad/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bkas bskul te 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad dang bcas te sgrub pa la byon/ chos lung dgon par sangs rgyas sum bcu so lnga la tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi rten mdzad pas zhal mthong*/ de'i tshe sman bla/ tshe dpag med/ byams pa rnams yang dang yang du gzigs/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bka' bzhin rdzing phyi'i lha khang zhig gsos byas nas logs bris mdzad pa'i skabs rnams su ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pas dngos su thim pa'i gzigs snang byung*/ lha bzos sangs rgyas so lnga'i sku mdog sogs 'bri tshul ma shes nas rje nyid la zhus pas so lnga dngos su byon nas sku mdog sogs ji lta bu yin pa rje nyid la bstan pa'i dper da lta'ang mchis/ rgya sog phu ru rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la sangs rgyas byang sems du ma dang 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang*/ in+d+ra bhū+i ti sa ra ha la sogs pa'i grub chen du mas bskor ba'i zhal gzigs shing*/ 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs ka'i phyag mtshan ral gri las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs nas rje'i thugs kar zhugs pa'i ltas khyad par can yang gzigs/ gnas der hor zla dang por cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus su rang rang gi phyogs mdog can gyi sangs rgyas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab par gzigs/

yang der 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku gzi brjid can zhig gzigs/ de phyin lam dus kyi dbang bzhi ma chad par blangs/ lho brag grub chen las gsang bdag gi chos skor rnams dang lung bstan rnams blangs/ tsa ri bskor nas gnyal du byon pa'i tshe mo la'i la rtsar rje btsun byams mgon ri rgyud tsam zhig dngos su gzigs pa'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la thub dbang rang nyid byon pa dang 'dra ba zhig 'ong bar shes pa gyis shig ces lung bstan te dbugs dbyung*/ seng ge rdzong du dus 'khor lugs kyi sbyor drug la dpyad pas thugs su chud pa'i tshe/ dus kyi 'khor lo dpa' gcig gis khyod rgyal po zla ba bzang po dang 'dra'o zhes bsngags/ gnyal du dbyangs can mas dgung lo 'di tsam zhig thub kyi/ de'i bar du gzhan gyi 'phrin las dpag med 'byung ngo zhes lung bstan/ dwags po lha sding dgon par mnal lam du 'phags pa yab sras lnga'i zhal gzigs shing*/ phyi nyin sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel pa bung+ngha pā li ta gzigs pas lta ba'i sgro 'dogs lhag ma med par mchod/ dben gnas du mar 'jam dbyangs kyis bstan bcos 'di dang 'di lta bu rtsoms shig dang ma 'ongs pa na bstan pa dang gdul bya la phan pa 'byung ngo zhes bskul ba ltar brtsams/ gzhan yang lha sar cho 'phrul gyi dus chen la mchod pa rgya ྄chen po mdzad pa'i phyag srol khyad par can da lta'i bar du dar ba 'di bzhin lags/ dgung lo nga drug pa 'brug gi lo la bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe thugs dam la bsgrims pas thun mong min pa'i bde stong gi nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs shing*/ gser gyi ri dbang ltar brjid pa'i ston pa bcom ldan 'das zhal gzigs pa'i tshe rang la bstims pas dbyer med du gyur/ snyun las ma grol ba'i bar bar du sgrol ma rnam rgyal gdugs dkar 'od zer can sogs yi dam du ma dang khyad par du gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po dang rdo rje'i 'jigs byed gnyis yang yang zhal gzigs shing gsol ba btab pas sku tshe'i bar chad zhi/

de'i tshe mgon po chos rgyal sogs chos skyong rnams kyis bar chad byed pa'i bdud dang 'byung po bzung nas 'khrid de 'ong ba sku mdun du sleb pa na bsgral ba'i tshe/ phyi rol du bdud sde'i dmag dpung pham mo zhes pa'i sgra chen po grags/ phyag drug pa sogs chos skyong rnams kyis rang rang gi gzugs bstan nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las sna tshogs mdzad cing*/ khyad par du'ang las kyi gshin rjes sna tshogs pa'i gzugs su sprul nas gtam du ma gleng ba dang ci gsung bka' bzhin du sgrub/ dus dus su gdul bya rnams la mdo sngags kyi chos lung zab 'khrid man ngag sogs gnang zhing*/ bar bar du sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad/ 'dul ba'i phyag len rnams legs par btsugs nas dar bar byas/ mdo rgyud kyi dgongs 'grel du ma dang*/ phar phyin theg pa'i gzhung lugs rnams kyi brjod pa'i don nyams su len pa'i rim par bsdus nas lam rim chen mo dang*/ gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i brjod bya'i don thams cad nyams len du bsdus nas sngags rim chen mo mdzad cing*/ khyad par du gsang bde gnyis kyi skor rnams mdzad nas srol dar bar byas/ de ltar mdzad pa khyad par can gzhan mang du mchis mod/ bsdu na mdzad chen bzhi ste dga' ldan dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ rdzing phyi zhig gsos mchod 'bul/ lha sar cho 'phrul smon lam/ gnyal gyi lung ra chen mo bzhi'o/ /de'i nang nas chos 'phrul mchod pa ni bstan pa dang sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa rgya che ba'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dngos su grags pa ltar ro/ /de rnams la 'di skad ces bya ste/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa yang*/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs phyir/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid bsgrubs mdzad nas/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhal mngon mthong mtshar/ /the tshom bral yang the tshom ltar bcos nas/ /yongs su 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen yongs bsten te/ /lhag pa'i lha la lhag pa'i zab don gyi/

/som nyi'i tshul dris som nyi'i dra ba bcad/ /las sgrib med kyang de sbyor phyir/ rgyal ba nyi ma so lnga la/ rgyun du tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi /rten mdzad yang yang mngon sum gzigs/ /gang tshe rgyal ba'i gzugs brnyan gsar bskrun la/ /gang gis ye shes bcug pas dngos su zhugs/ /so lnga 'bri tshul ma shes zhugs pa ltar/ /so lnga dngos su byon nas bstan bzhin bris/ /'jam dbyangs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rgyan drug dang*/ /grub chen rgyu skar 'khor dang bcas/ /mngon sum gzigs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig /bzang bzang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun/ /mang mang nam mkha'i khams kun khyab pa dang*/ /'jigs 'jigs dus dgra zhal phyag rdzogs pa'i sku/ / gsal gsal mngon sum gzigs pas nyams rtogs 'phel/ /nam mkha'i mtshan can rgya mtsho las/ /gsang bdag chos skor rin chen blangs/ /rgyal tshab nyid kyis bstan 'di la/ /rgyal ba byon ltar 'byung zhes bstan/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug la/ /dpyad pa rdzogs tshe dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /tshangs sras lha mo'i zhal gzigs lung bstan cing*/ /'phags pa yab sras lngas kyang byin gyis brlabs/ /gang tshe yab sras lnga nyid kyis/ /gang la byin brlabs rjes bzung tshe/ /gang zhig dbu ma'i lta ba la/ /gang du'ang 'gyur med the tshom chod/ /rje btsun khyod la rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /bstan bcos 'di rtsoms bstan dang 'gro ba dang*/ /phan par 'gyur zhes phan thogs lung bstan bzhin/ /legs bshad sna tshogs legs par brtsams par mdzad/ /skye rga na 'chi dang bral yang*/ /dgos dbang gzhan don bsnyung ba'i tshul/ /bstan tshe gser gyi ri dbang lta'i/ /ston pa zhal gzigs dbyer med gyur/ /gang tshe thugs dam zab la brtson pa na/ /de tshe chos skyong mgon po 'khor bcas kyis/ /bdud dang gdon bgegs 'byung po bsgral ma thag /bdud sde'i dmag dpung pham pa'i sgra chen grags/

/chos rgyal mgon po la sogs pa/ /chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyis/ /chos rje khyod kyi lung rtogs bstan/ /chos bzhin skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes/ /blo gros bzang por grags pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /'phags bod mkhas grub yongs kyi mdzad pa kun/ /khyod nyid gcig pus bsdus nas bdag gir mdzad/ /de phyir mkhas grub kun gyi gtso bor 'os/ khyod kyi bshad sgrub rnam gnyis kyis/ /thub bstan yongs rdzogs bzung gzigs tshe/ /rgyal tshab mi pham mgon nyid kyis/ /da ni bdag gis ci bya dgongs/ / mgon po khyod kyis rgyal bstan bzung ba tsam/ /'dzam gling rgyan drug sogs kyis ma mdzad la/ khyod kyi 'phrin las phyogs mthar dar ba tsam/ /mkhas grub gzhan gyi mdzad pa nyid kyang min/ zhes bya'o/ /phag lo'i ston stod lung chab tshan la phebs nas 'bras spungs su 'byon pa'i tshe 'dod li la gdan drangs pas de'i sne la 'ja' tshon zug cing 'bras spungs su phebs nas chos gsungs pa'i chos grwa'i nang du 'ja' tshon kha dog sna lnga pa nam mkha' nas ka ba btsugs pa ltar zug /de'i tshe skya ser dpag tu med pa la lung khrid sogs gsung chos mang du gnang nas dga' ldan du byon/ sku tshe de tsam du ring ba min yang*/ chos kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin pa dang*/ mdzad pa'i rgyun rgyal tshab mkhas grub sogs bu slob khyad par can rnams la sgrub tu bcug na legs par dgongs nas de'i tshe sku cung zad snyung ba'i tshul bstan/ lo de ka'i bcu pa'i nyi shu lnga'i snga dro'i nyi ma shar rjes tsam du stong pa gsum rim gyis thim nas stong pa bzhi pa 'od gsal mngon du mdzad pa na/ sku 'od kyi phung po dang ldan pa'i lha gzhon nu lta bur gyur to/ /'od gsal de las bar do longs sku sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ 'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzad gyur pa/ /de tshe khyod sku 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ /bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa sgyu ma'i sku/

/mchog gi dngos grub brnyes zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'i tshe nam mkha' nas me tog sna tshogs kyi char bab cing*/ 'ja' tshon nam mkha' khyab par 'khrigs pa dang*/ lhas mchod cing dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsu bar byed pa'i ltas khyad par can byung*/ dad ldan phal cher yid mya ngan gyis gdungs shing lus la brdeg 'tshogs dang ngag gis smre ngag dang gsol gdab byed pa rnams phan tshun 'gran pa ltar gyur la/ gzhan dag ni e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'o zhes brjod cing*/ rje nyid la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes gong 'phel du gyur to/ /'dir rim pa gsum pa'i sgyu lus brnyes par bshad pa ni sku tshe de la las rgya ma brten pas bar dor mchog 'grub pa'i dbang du mdzad la/ bla ma kha cig nges donadu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid byon nas phyag rgya mdzad de sku tshe de la mchog brnyes kyang gsang bar mdzad do zhes gsungs/ de lta bu gang yin kyang sprul sku'i mdzad pa bston pa la mtha' ma bkag cing*/ sku tshe phyi ma la dga' ldan du 'khrungs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ de nas phag lo'i zla ba bcu pa yi/ mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i snga dro'i dus su ni/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul du ma'i tshogs bstan nas/ dga' ldan gnas su gshegs pa'i btsong kha pa/ zhes 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ dga' ldan du byams pa'i sras kyi thu bo 'jam dpal snying po zhes bya bar 'gyur ba ni/ sa gsum mar/ dga' ldan gnas su 'jam dpal snying por grags/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sku gdung ril po mchod rten du bzhugs pa ni grags che la/ da lta bcu pa'i lnga mchod mdzad pa'i rgyun dar ba ni rje gshegs pa'i dus mchod yin zhing*/ sku gshegs pa'i mdzad pa 'di tsam yang bstan pa dang sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa'i rgyur gyur te sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'o/ /mgon khyod zhing gzhan gshegs nye bar/ /tha ma'i gdul bya'i don dgongs nas/ /khyod la gshegs dang chos ston dus/

/dbang po'i gzhu yis lha lam mdzes/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings bsdu ba na/ /stong gsum rim thim stong pa bzhi pa yi/ 'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzad pa'i tshe/ /khyod sku gzhon nyams 'od gsal phung por gyur/ /'od gsal de las sgyu ma'i skur/ /mngon bzhengs byams pa'i zhabs drung du/ /gshegs tshe 'khor slob mgon bral nas/ /dad gdung lhan cig 'gran bzhin gyur/ /de tshe mig gi nam mkhar sprin med kyang*/ /mchi ma'i char bab yid la shing med kyang*/ /mya ngan me 'bar brang ngos rnga med kyang*/ /lag pa'i dbyu gus lan cig min pa brdung*/ / mkha' las 'dab rgya'i char rgyun dang*/ /dbang po'i mtshon gyis mdzes par spras/ /'chi med tshogs kyis mchod pa dang*/ /ḍā kis bsu ba'i rol sgra bsgrags/ /khyod kyi mdzad pa khyad can gzhan lta ci/ khyod sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan dang*/ /khyod gdung ril po bzhugs pa'i tshul 'dis kyang*/ / khyod nyid dngos su bzhugs ltar phan pa mdzad/ /zag med chos sku'i yon tan snod gyur zag med gzugs sku'i za ma tog /rin chen dang po sa le sbram sogs rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i/ /mchod sdong cher zhugs su zhig mthong dang mchod cing skyabs su bsten pa rnams/ /nges pa lha mi'i rten bzang rim brgyud nges par sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /khyod kyi yon tan mang mang rgya mtsho'i mtha'/ /ro 'dzin stong gis yang yang bsgrags byas kyang*/ /rdzogs par 'gyur min bsdus bsdus mtshon tsam 'dis/ /rje btsun khyod nyid dgyes dgyes mdzad gyur cig /ces bya'o/ /༈ gnyis pa gzhung don bye brag tu bshad pa la bzhi/ mchod par brjod pa/ dgos don bstan pa/ gzhung don bshad pa dngos mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ legs smon dang*/ mchod brjod dang*/ dang po ni/ oṃ bde legs su gyur cig ces pa ste/ oṃ ni mchog sogs don bdun la 'jug cing*/ sku gsung thugs mtshon par bshad pa sogs yod kyang 'dir tshig 'og ma'i 'go 'dren no/

/bde legs so sor phye na bde ba mngon mtho dang*/ legs pa ni nges legs su bshad pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig tu de las ldog ste bshad cing*/ nges legs nyid la'ang bde ba dang legs pa'i sgra 'jug pas gang rung ste/ gyur cig ni de thob par smon pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten mtho ris byang grol lta ba'i mig /srid lam 'khyams pas dub pa'i ngal so'i gnas/ /bde legs rtsa ba drin can bla ma dang*/ /rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter gyi zhabs la 'dud/ /ces pa ste/ 'jig rten gyi mtho ris mngon mtho dang*/ byang grol byang chub dang de dag 'grub pa'i thabs legs par ston cing bstan pa ltar gdul byas kyang tshul de mthong bar 'gyur bas der lta ba'i mig lta bu dang*/ srid pa 'khor ba'i lam du 'khyams pas ngal zhing dub pa'i 'gro ba rnams nges legs la 'god pa'i sgo nas ngal gso ba'i gnas su gyur pa bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i rtsa ba chos ston pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs la 'dud do zhes so/ /gnyis pa dgos pa ni/ 'bad pa chung dus rlabs chen tshogs sdud la/ zhes pa nas/ sems khyod dga' ba 'di ltar bskyed na legs/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ rang gi 'bad pa chen po ma yin pa'i chung ngu tsam zhig gis bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs chen sdud cing gsog pa la ni rang gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba la dga' ba bsgom shing rjes su yi rang ba mchog gam khyad par du 'phags par ston pas mdo sde du ma las gsungs shing*/ khyad par du rang gis sngon byas pa'i dge ba bden par zhen pa'i rlom sems dang bral bas dga' ba rgya cher bskyed na ni rang gi sngon byas pa'i dge ba rnams gong du 'phel lo zhes rgyal bas gsungs pa'i don de bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ der ma zad dgos pa gzhan yang bstan pa la 'jug pa'i tshul de 'dra zhig dgos par shes pa sogs mang du mthong ba ni/

sems khyod dge ba la dga' ba 'chad 'gyur 'di ltar bskyed na legs so zhes rang la bskur ma ltar mdzad do/ /rang gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang na phan yon che tshul yan lag bdun pa ston pa'i mdo bstan bcos du ma dang*/ khyad par rjes su yi rang sgom lam 'chad pa'i yum gyi mdo rnams dang*/ de dag gi dgongs 'grel kun dang*/ de rnams kyi don bsdu na mtshon tsam ni sdud pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su yi rang sems gcig la/ /nyan thos tshogs kyi bsod nams phung pos char mi phod/ ces pa dang*/ stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal bas tshad bzung rung*/ /rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de lta min/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang rang gis byas pa'i dge ba la yi rang na dge ba rnams gong 'phel du 'gyur bar gsungs shing*/ gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing yi rang na bsod nams thob mnyam du 'byung ste lag rjes so so ba'o/ /'grel pa don gsal las/ rang dang gzhan gyi bsod nams bya ba mnyam pa nyid du thob po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba la rjes su yi rang na bsod nams mnyam thob yin yang*/ che chung mnyam pa'i nges pa med de/ sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba'i de dang che chung mnyam pa mi 'thob pa lta bu'o/ /che chung mnyam pa dang lhag pa'ang 'thob par 'gyur srid de/ sngon rgyal po zhig gis khengs dregs kyis ston pa 'khor bcas la mchod cing bsnyen bkur rgya cher byas pa la bud med dbul mo zhig gis dga' ba shugs chen byas pas bud med des rgyal po'i bsod nams las kyang lhag thob pa'i lo rgyus 'dug pa ltar ro/ /dge bar ma zad yon tan can dang chos sgrub pa'i gang zag la'ang dga' zhing yi rang na bsod nams che bar bshad pas 'bad pa chung ngus tshogs gsog pa la 'di gal che'o/ /rigs pa des dge ba byas pa mi dga' ba dang chos sgrub mkhan dang yon tan can dag la phrag dog gis mi dga' bar byas na bsod nams 'grib pa'ang rten 'brel gyi chos nyid du grub po/

/de bzhin du mi dge ba byas pa la yi rang zhing dga' bar byas na mi dge ba gsog par 'gyur tshul yang sngar dang 'dra'o/ /'dir rlom sems bral ba ni bden 'dzin med pa la byed dgos pa yum gyi mdo las gsal te/ rgyu mtshan ni spyir chos rnams rang bzhin gyis med cing khyad par du 'dus byas dge ba'i las ni rang bzhin gyis stong pa sgyu ma lta bu gsog gsob ya ma brla dang bden par grub pa'i snying po med par shes na phan yon lhag par che ste/ sdud pa las/ bsod nams gsog dang de bzhin stong pa dang*/ /gsob dang ya ma brla dang snying po med shes par/ /de ltar bde gshegs rnams kyi shes rab spyod byed na/ /spyod tshe bsod nams dpag tu med pa yongs su 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / rnam dkar dge ba rang gis bgyis pa dang*/ /rnam dag gzhan gyis byas la yi rang na/ /rnam mang bsod nams 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes/ /rnam kun mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs/ /rang gi lus ngag 'bad rtsol gyis/ /ma bsgrubs gzhan gyis bskrun pa la/ /yid kyi dga' ba bsgoms tsam las/ / bsod nams phung po 'byung 'di mtshar/ /'on kyang sgyu ma lta bu'i dkar nag gi / las rnams sgrub la yid byed dbang btsan phyir/ /sa bon sems bskyed stobs ldan rgyal sras kyi/ /myu gus rang 'bras sangs rgyas myur bskrun 'gyur/ /gsum pa gzhung don bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ 'dun ma legs pa'i dga' ba dang bcas pa'i bka' drin dran pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dang po rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal/ /zhes pa nas/ kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos/ zhes so/ /blo bzang grags pa'i dpal kho bo rab tu byung nas dus dang por gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la thos pa rgya chen po mang du btsal cing*/ bar du gzhung lugs de thams cad gdams par shar la/ tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu de rnams kyi don gyi gnad bsdus pa'i snying po nyams su blangs nas/

de las byung ba'i dge ba kun kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshul 'di bsam shing sogs rkang pa gnyis ste/ de ltar thos sogs gsum dang de'i dge ba bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos pa'i tshul 'di bsams shing bltas pa na bdag gi tshe 'di'i 'dun ma'i bya ba legs nas gda' ste/ de yang bla ma dam pa rnams dang khyad par rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyi bka' drin yin pas/ bka' drin che'o rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter zhes bka' drin brjod de mtshan nas bos pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ dang po thos pa ji ltar mdzad tshul/ bar du gzhung lugs gdams par shar tshul/ tha mar nyams len ji ltar mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum/ thos pa med la thar lam gyi khyad par legs par mi shes pas der ji ltar 'jug tshul yang mi shes pa/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis thos pa mdzad tshul spyir bstan 'dun legs dang bcas pa/ de nas thos pa'i rim pa so sor mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ blang dor gnas rnams kun la 'thoms pa'i mun/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ blang bya dang dor bya'i gnas rnams la kun nas 'thoms shing rmongs pa'i blo mun de/ gsung rab du ma la sbyangs pa'i yang dag pa'i thos pa'i sgron mes ma bsal bar thar lam de ji ltar yin legs par mi shes na/ lam du bzhugs nas thar ba'i grong mchog tu 'jug par 'gyur nus pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te mi nus so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nyid phyir na mi pham chos rje dang*/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi 'dun legs dang bcas pa ste/ rgyu mtshan brjod ma thag pa de nyid kyi phyir na bdag gis mi pham chos rje byams mgon dang*/ klu sgrub ār+ya de ba thogs med dang dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos grags te 'dzam gling rgyan drug dang*/ yon shāka gnyis la mchog gnyis zhes yongs su grags pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung la phyogs re ba tsam dang*/

rags pa re sbyangs pa tsam gyis tshim par ma byas par mkhas pa de dag gi gzhung kun la zhib tu sbyangs so/ /sbyangs tshul 'ga' zhig ni sngar bshad cing 'chad par yang 'gyur ro/ /'dun legs kyi don sngar ltar gzhan la'ang sbyor/ gsum pa la mdo sngags gnyis kyi dang po la gnyis/ tshad ma'i skor la mdzad pa dang*/ lta ba'i skor la mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ khyad par tshu rol mthong bas dngos po yi/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ gzhung lugs kun sbyangs tshul spyir bstan pa de ltar yin yang*/ khyad par du tshu rol mthong ba'i so skyes dngos po yi de kho na nyid kyi gnas tshul rigs pa'i rnam grangs mang pos gtan la 'bebs pa'i 'byung gnas kyi sgo gcig pu ni phyogs glang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i yang dag pa'i rigs gzhung rnams yin la/ gzhung de dag gi dka' ba'i gnas rnams la 'bad pa chung ngu dang lan cig tsam ma yin par 'bad pa chen po du mas yang dang yang du rgyun bsrings nas sbyangs so/ /gnas gang dang gang la brten nas sbyangs pa ni grwa sa du mar yongs 'dzin mang po dang*/ khyad par du rje btsun red mda' ba'i drung du sbyangs pa'o/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas gzhon nu blo gros sogs/ / mkhas par grags pa'i mkhas pa mang bsten nas/ /rigs tshul ston pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung rnams la/ /legs par sbyangs pas legs par thugs su chud/ /khyod blo gsal ba'i ded dpon mchog /rigs gzhung rgya mtshor zhugs tsam las/ /don bzang yin bzhin nor rnyed kyi/ /mkhas rlom byis gzhan mching bu btsal/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdo sngags gzhung la ngal ba mang byas kyang*/ /zhes sogs rkang pa brgyad de/ bod yul 'di na kha cig mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung du ma la thos bsam gyi ngal ba mang du byas kyang*/ zab mo'i don nyams su len pa dang 'chad cing smra ba'i tshe na/ shes bya gang yang ma bslabs shing don ci yang mi shes pa'i lta ba skyong ba'i tshul dang*/ 'chad tshul las ma 'das shing ring du ma song bar mthong nas/

lhag par mgon po klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs nas 'byung ba ltar gyi zab mo'i 'byed pa'i phra ba'i rigs pa'i lam nas/ yang dag pa'i lta ba skye zhing 'dren pa'i gnad kun la zhib tu legs par sbyangs te the tshom mchod par byas so/ /dbu ma'i skor 'di rje btsun re mda' ba sogs las gsan la gtso bor dang por bla ma dbu ma pa la brten nas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las gsan cing*/ phyis rjes btsun gyi zhal gzigs nas dngos su gsan pa'i tshul rnam thar sogs las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /gang yang ma bslabs ci yang mi shes pa'i lta ba'i tshul las ring du ma song ba'i don ni/ sngon gyi bka' rgyud pa dang gzhan phyogs pa 'ga' zhig lta ba nyams su len pa la thos pa mi dgos kyi sems ma g.yeng ba'i tsom 'jog tsam gyis mchog par 'dod pa dang*/ sems ci yang ma grub par bzung ba tsam dang*/ sems kha dog dang dbyibs su ma grub par rtogs shing bsgoms pa tsam gyis lta ba sgom par 'dod pa byung zhing de dag gi ltar na dbu ma'i lta ba rnyed pa ches sla bar 'gyur te/ tshul de lta bu ni sbyangs pa ma byas pa'i dbang po rtul pos kyang nges nus pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhung mang po la sbyangs kyang lta ba sgom tshul de ltar byed na gang yang ma bslabs shing ci yang mi shes pa'i lta ba skyong tshul dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /khyod blo 'od stong ldan shar tshe/ /zab don dbu ma'i 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /'dzum bsu mkhas rlom zla 'od kyis/ /mi phyed me 'khyer 'od kyis ci/ /gangs can gangs ri dkar yang lta ngan gyi/ /mun pa mun nag stugs pos khyab pa na/ /rab dkar rab gsal smra ba'i zla ba khyod/ /shar nas shar te nub phyogs mun tshogs bcom/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ sngags lam du mi 'jug par mi rigs tshul/ sngags la 'jug tshul spyir bstan pa/ so sor phye nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di ni rdzogs sangs rgyas su bgrod pa la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/

gangs can 'di na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bgrod pa'i lam la zab mo rdo rje theg pa dang*/ phar phyin theg pa rnam pa gnyis yod cing*/ de gnyis las gsang sngags kyi theg pa ni phar phyin theg pa las lam gyi bgrod ba myur bas shin tu khyad par du 'phags pa yin no zhes nyi ma dang zla ba grags che ba lta bur kun tu grags so/ /de ltar grags pa'i tshig dai bden pa'i tshig tu 'dod cing khas len bzhin du/ zab mo sngags kyi theg pa ji lta bu zhig yin zhes tshol bar mi byed par/ tha snyad rig pa dang gtan tshigs rig pa lta bu tsam la mkhas par byas nas/ de tsam gyis rang nyid mkhas so snyam du mkhas pa'i khur 'dzin pa de 'dra ba de yang shes rab chen po can yin no zhes 'dod na/ 'o na de las gzhan pa'i dbang po rtul po de gang yin smros zhig ces pa ste/ don la de lta bu de nyid dbang rtul yin no zhes 'phangs so/ /rgyu mtshan ni/ mkhas par rlom yang shin tu 'phrad par dka' zhing gong na lam gzhan med pa'i zab mo sngags kyi lam 'di 'dra ba mchog tu mthong ba dang 'jug 'dod kyi blo med par rang dgar bzung nas yal bar 'dor ba'i phyir ro/ /kye ma'o mtshar zhes pa la/ spyir kye ma dang mtshar ba ni/ bsngags pa la 'jug pa yod kyang 'dir gnyis ka'ang smod pa'i tshig go /gnyis pa ni/ de nyid phyir na rgyal ba'i theg pa mchog /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ sngags lam du mi 'jug pa mi rigs pa'i rgyu mtshan sngar bshad pa de nyid kyi phyir na/ bdag gis rgyal ba'i theg pa kun gyi mchog sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i rdo rje theg pa mchog thun gyi dngos grub rnam pa gnyis kyi gter du gyur pa der zhugs nas 'bad pa mang pos ring du sbyangs so/ /mang mang tha snyad rig gnas gtan tshigs la/ /yang yang legs par sbyangs pa'i mkhas rlomadag /zab zab gsang sngags rgya mtshor mi 'jug na/ /nges nges yid bzhin nor bu 'dor bar sems/

/ji ltar 'od stong can shar tshe/ /sna tshogs gzugs rnams gsal mthong bzhin/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i nyi shar bas/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde'i don kun gsal/ / mgon khyod rnam dpyod yangs pa'i hub gcig gis/ /gsang sngags rgyud don rgya mtsho'i 'thung gzigs tshe/ sa ra ha sogs grub chen klu dbang rnams/ /dag pa mkha' sbyod gnas su bros sam snyam/ /gsum pa so sor phye ste 'chad pa la bzhi/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud la sbyangs pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rgyud sde'i 'og ma'i lam bgrod tshul mi shes na gong ma'i lam gyi khyad par legs par mi shes pa dang*/ des na rgyud sde'i 'og ma la thos pa mdzad tshul dngos so/ /dang po ni/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lam gyi tshul/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud dang bcas pa'i rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lam gyi bgrod tshul ji ltar yin legs par shes dgos shing de mi shes na ni gang zag de yis rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud de rgyud sde bzhi po kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa yin no zhes tshig gis brjod cing bsam pas thag bcad kyang*/ tshul de ni tshad mas nges shes thob pa'i dam bca' min gyi/ yid dpyod kyi dam bca' tsam du zad par legs par mthong ngo*/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud legs par grub pa dang*/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ de ltar mthong nas bdag gis bya rgyud kyi nang tshan gsang ba spyi rgyud dang*/ legs par grub pa'i rgyud dang*/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa dang*/ bsam gtan phyi ma sogs bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi dang*/ bye brag gi rgyud sde rnams la ring du 'dris par byas so/ /'dir de dag gi khyad par cung zad tsam brjod na/ bya rgyud la 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs gnyis kyi dang po la/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ pad+ma dang*/

rdo rje rigs gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bor shākya thub pa de'i sgrub thabs ston pa dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po/ /rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dbyangs/ de'i rgyud 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang dpa' bo gcig sgrub/ rigs kyi yum grwa lnga dang 'od zer can/ rigs kyi gtsug tor gdugs dkar/ rnam rgyal/ dri med/ rigs kyi sems dpa' byams pa/ /rigs kyi khro bo mi g.yo ba/ /khro mo dbyangs can ma sogs so/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /bdag po spyan ras gzigs/ yum sgrol ma/ khro bo rta mgrin/ khro mo rdo rje lu gu rgyud sogs so/ /rdo rje rigs kyi gtso bo mi 'khrugs pa/ bdag po phyag rdor/ yum khro gnyer can/ khro bo stobs po che/ khro mo lo ma gyon ma sogs so/ /'jig rten pa'i rigs la gnod sbyin gyi rigs sogs gsum/ rigs gsum spyi'i rnam gzhag ston pa'i rgyud ni bzhi ste gsang ba spyi rgyud kyis dkyil 'khor sum stong lnga brgya'i cho ga dang bcas pa dang*/ legs grub kyi khro bo grub pa la brten nas 'gegs bzlog tshul dang rigs sngags kyi cho ga las rab 'byams dang bcas pa dang*/ rigs gsum gyi bzlas pa sogs ston/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las spyi rgyud nas bstan pa'i dbang gi yan lag dang sbyin sregs sogs kyi las rab 'byams ston/ bsam gtan phyi mas bya rgyud kyi lam rnams de nyid bcur bsdus nas ston/ bya spyod gnyis phal cher 'gros 'thun cing*/ don bsdu na bzlas brjod dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan dang*/ bzlas brjod la mi bltos pa'i bsam gtan dang*/ sngon du bsnyen pa byas nas dngos grub sgrub pa'i tshul gsum du bsdus nas 'chad ba sngags rim gyi lugs so/ /bzlas brjod dang bcas pa ni/ sangs rgyas gsang bas/ mchod dang gsol bas lha drug bsgom/ /stong pa yi ge sgra gzugs dang*/ /phyag rgya mtshan ma drug yin ste/

/zhes dang*/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /zhes sogs gsungs te don rgyas par bshad na mang du dogs pas mtshon tsam mo/ /bzlas brjod la mi ltos pa'i bsam gtan ni/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/ gsang sngags mi gnas dngos grub ster/ /sgra gnas rnal 'byor ster bar dran/ /sgra mthar thar pa star ba nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud sde gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud rnams kyi/ /zhes sogs rkang ba bzhi ste/ rgyud sde bzhi'i gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud rnams kyi gtso bor gyur pa ni rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud yin la/ de la sbyangs pas spyod pa'i rgyud kun dang de'i phyogs gtogs kyi rgyud gang yin pa de yang legs par nges par byas so/ /de yang rtsa rgyud rnam snang mngon pa byang chub pa'i rgyud la rim pa phye ba nyer drug rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa ste dkyil 'khor gsum ston/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs yin la/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud bod du ma 'gyur zhing*/ rdo rje rigs ni phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /lam gyi rim pa phal cher bya rgyud dang 'dra yang lha drug bskyed mi gsal/ bzlas brjod la phyi dang nang gi yan lag bzhi bzhi ste/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /zhes pa'i gzhi la bdag gzhan gnyis su phye ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyud sde gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kyi/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ rgyud sde gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gtso bo ni dpal ldan rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud dang*/ de'i bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo dang*/ spyod rgyud dang*/ dpal mchog dang*/ cha mthun gyi rgyud sogs la legs par sbyangs pas rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dga' ston myong bar byas so/ /de la rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa'i gling gzhis rnam snang bstan/ lhag ma rdor dbyings dang*/ khams gsum rgyal/ 'gro 'dul/

don grub kyi dum bzhis rnam snang sogs rigs bzhi ston/ lam la mtshan bcas mtshan med gnyis ste/ mtshan bcas la lha'i rnal 'byor phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs tshul bzlas pa las tshogs bcas pa dang*/ mtshan med la lha'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i stong nyid sgom tshul dang bcas pa ston te mtshon pa tsam mo/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor tsam ni rgyud sde bzhi ka'i skabs su yod do/ /bzhi pa ni/ bzhi ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa la/ /zhes sogs rkang pa brgyad de/ rgyud sde bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla med la dbye na/ 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa rnams la nyi ma dang zla ba ltar yongs su grags pa'i pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kye rdor gyi rgyud rtag gnyis dang*/ bde mchog gi rtsa ba'i rgyud nyung ngu dang bshad pa'i rgyud mngon brjod kun sbyor la sogs pa dang*/ mdo dang rgyud sde gzhan sngon ma de dag dang bshad pa'i lugs srol mi 'dra ba'i shing rta'i srol chen dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus rgyud dang*/ de'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi don gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos chen mo rigs ldan pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa'i 'grel chen dri ma med pa'i 'od la legs par sbyangs so/ /gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum ni/ pha rgyud du gtogs shing*/ dus 'khor ngo bo rnal 'byor ma rgyud du gtogs so/ /rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang du mdzad nas rgyud sde stong phrag sum cu rtsa bzhir bshad cing*/ bla med kyi dbang du byas nas sdom 'byung las/ rnal 'byor rnams kyi rgyud kyi tshad/ /bye ba phrag ni drug tu nges/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grangs bye ba phrag ni bcu drug grags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bla med kyi rgyud don thams cad dbang bskur rim gnyis yan lag dang bcas par 'du tshul sngags rim sogs nas 'byung ba ltar te 'dir mang du dogs so/ /rjes sngags kyi skor phal cher khyung po lhas pa las gsan cing*/

rje btsun re mda' pa las 'dus pa'i skor legs par gsan/ /dus 'khor ni bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan dang chos rje dpal pa la gsan cing*/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dbang lung lag len rnams chos rje dpal ba dang khyung lhas dang grags pa rgyal mtshan las gsan/ rgyud sde bzhi'i gnad rtogs dka' ba 'ga' zhig ni rje btsun 'jam dbyangs las gsan no/ /dus kyi 'khor lo ni rgyud sde gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra ste/ mtshon tsam ni dus 'khor lugs la ri rab dang ri bdun gyi dbyibs zlum po dang tshad kyang mngon pa dang mi 'dra zhing*/ der ma zad 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang gling bzhi'i tshad kyang snga ma dang mi 'dra la/ sbyor drug gi tha snyad gsungs kyang 'dus pa'i sbyor drug dang mi 'dra ba sogs mang ste mtshon tsam mo/ /thub gsung chu gter chen po las/ / gsang sngags sa 'dzin dbang po 'khrungs/ /rnam bzhi'i rgyud kyi bang rim can/ / dngos grub sku bzhi'i lcog gis mdzes/ /rdzogs ldan dus su gsang sngags nam mkha' la/ /dbang lung man ngag chu 'dzin 'khrigs tsam gyis/ /gdul bya smin pa'i zhing sa dag pa las/ /dngos grub gnyis kyi char chen myur du 'bebs/ / deng dus gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /dbang 'khrid man ngag than sbrin las/ / bshad pa'i rnga gsang cher bsgrags kyang*/ /dngos grub char rgyun dka' bar mthong*/ /'on kyang bla ma'i rnam dpyod srub shing gis/ /rgyud sde'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung ba'i/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi cha tsam myang bas kyang*/ / mngon mtho nges legs srog rten 'gyur bar nges/ /blo bzang zla ba'i 'od dkar shar tsam gyis/ /thub bstan 'dzin ma gos dkar gyon pa dang*/ /lhan cig gsang sngags kun+da 'dzum byas pas/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di yang bskal ba bzang*/ /skabs bsdu ni/ dang po rgya chen po mang du thos pa btsal ba'i skabs te dang po'o/ /zhes so// //༈ gnyis pa bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar tshul la gnyis/

gdams par 'char ba'i rgyu bstan pa dang*/ gdams par shar tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de nas gdul bya'i blo mun sel ba'i mchog /ces sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ dang por thos pa de ltar byas pa de nas bdag gis gdul bya'i blo'i rmongs mun sel ba'i lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs la shugs drag po dang rgyun ring gi dad pa brtan pos/ sngar thos pa mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs de rnams nyams len gyi gdams pa ru 'char ba'i phyir du gsol ba drag tu btab cing*/ bsags sbyangs sogs kyi rgyu tshogs kun la 'bad par byas so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ mdo phyogs gdams par shar tshul dang*/ sngags phyogs gdams par shar tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ phar phyin gdams par shar tshul dang*/ gzhan gdams par shar tshul lo/ /dang po ni de ltar 'bad pas klu sgrub thogs med las/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ thos pa'i phyogs la de ltar 'bad pas mgon po klu sgrub dang 'phags pa thogs med gnyis las rim pa bzhin du rgyud pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i nges pa rnyed par gyur pas zab mo'i gzhung mchog phar phyin gdams par shar ro/ /de yang mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel dang*/ jo bos mdzad pa'i lam sgron sogs la brten nas phar phyin gdams ngag tu shar ba'i 'bras rtags byang chub lam rim che chung sogs kyi rtsom pa mdzad cing de nas 'byung ba ltar yin la/ 'dir mtshon tsam ni/ rgyal ba'i chos tshul ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad kyang gdul bya rnams mngon mtho dang nges legs thob pa'i ched du yin zhing*/ thams cad kyang skyes bu gsum gyi las kyi lam rim pa ci rigs la rim gyis 'khrid nas mthar 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs ston pa'o/ /de las thog mar ngan song las thar thabs gtso bor ston pa rnams skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skor dngos sam de'i sder gtogs dang*/ 'khor ba spyi las thar ba'i thabs gtso bor ston pa rnams skyes bu 'bring gi chos skor dngos sam de'i sder gtogs dang*/

snying rje sems bskyed sogs sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs gtso bor ston pa rnams skyes bu chen po'i chos skor dngos sam de'i sder gtogs ci rigs su 'du ste/ skyes bu chen po'i chos skor la ni mdo sngags gnyis so/ /mdo phyogs de thams cad kyang lam rim ltar skyes bu gsum gyi lam la 'khrid tshul la go ba chags shing nges pa rnyed pa ni/ gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu shar ba dang*/ khyad par du mdo phyogs spyi dang phar phyin gdams ngag tu shar ba'o/ /spyir mdo dang de'i dgongs 'grel thams cad kyang gdams ngag yin mod/ de rnams gdams ngag tu go ba ni lam rim lta bu bla ma'i man ngag dgos kyi/ rang stobs kyis go bar mi nus so/ /gdams ngag gi sgra don ni/ mngon mtho nges legs 'grub pa'i thabs legs par 'doms pa'i don no/ /theg dman gyi sde snodang de'i lam yang 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs yin te/ sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya dbang po dman pa dang po dman pa'i lam la 'khrid de rgyud smin pa na rim gyis theg chen gyi lam la 'khrid par mdzad de thabs mkhas pa'o/ /des na theg dman pas rang lam du sangs rgyas don du mi gnyer bas rang bde gcig pu zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo lta bu sangs rgyas thob byed kyi thabs khyad par can min yang de'i thabs yin pa la 'gal ba ci yang med do/ /de dag nas 'byung ba'i gling gzhi dang lo rgyus sogs 'ga' zhig gis lam gyi khyad par dngos su mi ston yang*/ de dang de'i sder gtogs su 'jog cing*/ theg chen gyi mdo nas ngan song dang 'khor ba las grol ba'i thabs gtso bor ston pa rnams kyis ni skyes bu chung 'bring gi lam dngos sam de dang thun mong ba'i lam ston pas de'i rigs gnas dang sder gtogs so/ /ji ltar khams kyi chu phran tshogs/ /rgya mtsho 'bab cing 'du ba ltar/ /de bzhin gsung rab chu klung gzhan/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam du 'du/

/mang mang pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs kun/ /bzang bzang skyes bu gsum gyi lam tshul la/ /nges nges 'khrid byed gdams pa'i mchog nyid du/ /gsal gsal shar ba rje btsun khyod las su/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ tshad ma'i gzhung gdams ngag tu shar tshul dang*/ phar phyin gyi skor gzhan gdams ngag tu shar tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ tshad gzhung gdams ngag tu 'char ba'i gegs phyogs sngar bshad pa dang*/ de gdams ngag tu shar tshul dngos so/ /dang po ni/ byang phyogs 'di na tshad ma'i gzhung rnams la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis te/ 'phags yul gyi byang phyogs bod yul 'di na tshad ma'i gzhung la sbyangs pa sngon gyi sa skya'i mkhas pa du ma dang*/ bu ston rin po che dang*/ stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs 'ga' zhig dang*/ ma sbyangs pa bka' rgyud pa kha cig dang*/ gzhan phyogs pa du ma mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces slob dpon phyogs glang gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i mdo kun las btus pa dang*/ dpal chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i tshad ma rnam 'grel/ rnam nges/ rig thig /gtan tshigs thig pa/ 'brel pa brtags pa/ rtsod pa'i rig pa/ rgyud gzhan grub pa ste tshad ma sde bdun rnams las ni pha rol gzhan gyi grub mtha' la dgag sgrub byed pa'i rtog ge'i rigs pa tsam gtso bor ston pa'i phyi rig pa yin gyi/ byang chub tu bgrod pa'i lam nyams su len pa'i rim pa bstan pa yod pa min pas nang rig pa ston pa'i gzhung min zer zhing*/ sngon 'phags yul du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po la zhal bstan nas gsung gis dngos su khyod kyis tshad ma kun las btus pa'i bstan bcos 'di rtsoms shig dang*/ 'di ni ma 'ongs pa na gdul bya'i 'gro ba kun gzhung gzhan la lta ba'i mig lta bur 'gyur ro zhes gsung gi gnang ba stsal ba'ang tshad mar 'dzin par byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ni mi rigs smra ba'i phul byung du/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bcu gsungs te/

sngar ltar smra ba'i tshul de ni smra ba ngan pa mi rigs pa smra ba'i phul byung du mthong nas/ lhag par yang tshad mar gzhung gi brjod bya ston pa'i tshul der rigs pas dpyad pa na/ tshad ma kun las btus pa'i mchod brjod/ tshad mar gyur par 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag btsal te/ /zhes pa'i don/ dpal ldan chos kyi grags pas/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi le'u gnyis pa ston pa tshad ma'i skyes bur grub pa'i le'u las/ lugs 'byung lugs bzlog gi rigs pa'i spro nas rnam grol don du gnyer ba la ston pa bcom ldan 'das tshad ma'i skyes bur bsgrubs shing*/ de la brten nas kho bos kyang le'u gnyis pa de las ston pa de yi bstan pa kho na thar 'dod kyi 'jug ngogs te 'jug pa'i lam mam gzhi nges pa gting thag pa nas rnyed do/ /de ltar rnyed pas theg pa che chung gnyis kyi lam gyi gnad kun gcig tu 'dril bar rigs pa yang dag gi lam nas thon pas lhag par yid la dga' ba dpag med skyes so/ /dga' ba khyad par can skyes tshul ni/ rje 'dis rnam 'grel la thos bsam mdzad pa'i tshe/ rnam 'grel gyi ṭik+ka rnam bshad rigs mdzod la gzigs pa'i skabs du mar rnam 'grel gyi rigs pa'i gnad phra mo rnams ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i rkyen gyis e ma ngo mtshar che'o snyam du dgongs shing rnam 'grel gyi rigs pa'i srol la dad pa tshad med pa 'khrungs pa'i chos kyi shugs kyis spyan chab yang yang 'ong ba zhig byung ste/ tshul 'di ni 'ga' zhig rnam thar sogs mthong zhing thos pa na mchi ma 'byung ba tsam dang mi 'dra ste/ 'di ni gzhung zab mo'i don phra mo'ang legs par dgongs pa'i nang gi rnam 'gyur phyir thon pa yin zhing*/ sa rab tu dga' ba lta bu thob pa'i ltas chen po ste/ gnas brtan rab 'byor la chos kyi shugs kyis mchi ma byung ba bzhin no/ /tshad ma kun btus kyi mchod brjod kyi tshad ma zhes pa'i don rnam 'grel gyis 'chad pa ni/

tshad ma bslu med can shes pa/ /zhes pa nas/ de ldan bcom ldan tshad ma nyid/ /ces pa'i bar dang*/ gyur pa zhes pa don ni/ ma skyes pa ni bzlog don du/ /zhes pa nas/ tshur shog bya rgod bsten par gyis/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ 'gro la phan bzhed pa zhes pa'i don ni/ sgrub byed thugs rje goms las de/ /zhes pa nas/ chags bral chags dang yid lag bzhin/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ ston pa zhes pa'i don ni/ brtse ldan sdug bsngal gzhoms pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ gnyis po 'di ni rgyu ru bshad/ /ces pa'i bar dang*/ bde gshegs zhes pa'i don ni/ rgyu spangs yon tan gsum bde gshegs/ /zhes pa nas/ de shes pa yang grub pa yin/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ skyob pa'i don ni/ skyob pa nyid gzigs lam gsung ba/ zhes sogs kyis 'chad cing*/ mdor na lugs 'byung gi skabs su ston pa rgyu bsam pa snying rje chen po sems bskyed dang bcas pa dang*/ sbyor ba phyin drug gi nyams len las 'khrungs par bsgrubs shing*/ lugs bzlog gi skabs su ston pa las bsam sbyor de gnyis dang 'phrin las phun tshogs 'byung bar 'chad do/ /yang*/ de phyir tshad yin/ zhes pa yan gyis ston pa lugs 'byung gi sgo nas tshad ma'i skyes bur bstan nas/ de ltar 'khrungs pa'i gtan tshigs dang bcas te lugs bzlog gi 'khrungs tshul ni/ yang na skyob/ / bden pa bzhi ni ston mdzad pa'o/ /zhes pa nas/ gang phyir des na tshad ma nyid/ /ces pa'i bar ro/ /rjes/ de ni mi rigs smra ba'i phul byung du/ /mthong nas lhag par tshul der dpyad pa na/ /tshad ma kun las btus pa'i mchod brjod don/ /tshad ma grub par lugs 'byung lugs bzlog gis/ /rnam grol don du gnyer la bcom ldan 'das/ /tshad mar bsgrubs shing zhes gsungs pa 'di la stag tshang lo tsā bas rigs mtshungs kyi thal ba zhig 'phangs nas/ rjes tshad ma kun btus dang rnam 'grel gnyis kyis nang don rig pa bstan pa la dgag pa ltar snang zhig byas 'dug kyang*/

lo tsā ba ni mkhas pa yin yang kho rang mdo dang rnam 'grel gyis nang rig pa ma bstan pa'i lugs bzung nas phyogs zhen tsam yin snang zhing*/ rje'i bzhed pa la klan ka ltar snang de ga la 'jug /lo tsā ba 'dis grub mtha' kun shes las rje'i gzhung la 'gal ba'i dgag pa du ma zhig byas shing*/ khyad par du rigs gnas kun shes su skabs 'di la byang phyogs 'di na sgra yi gzhung lugs la/ /zhes sogs rigs mtshungs kyi thal ba 'phangs pa'i don rgyas par bshad cing dgag sgrub byas na mang du dogs pas bsdu na kho na re/ tshad ma mdo dang rnam 'grel sogs nang don rig pa ston pa'i gzhung ma yin par thal/ de yin na tsan+d+ra pa dang kā la ba sogs sgra gzhung rnams kyang nang rig pa ston pa'i gzhung yin par thal ba'i phyir zhes zer ba yin la/ lan yang mtshon pa tsam zhig ni/ tshad gzhung dang sgra gzhung gnyis brjod bya ston tshul mi mtshungs te/ sgra gzhung gis sgra'i sbyor ba tsam ston pa yin zhing*/ tshad gzhung rnam 'grel le'u gnyis par bden bzhi'i nyams len rgyas par rigs pa'i rnam grangs du ma'i sgo nas bstan pa de khyod kyis e gzigs/ ma gzigs na mun mda' gang la 'phen/ gzigs na bden bzhi'i rnam pa gtso bor ston pa'i rnam 'grel gyi gzhung de nang don rig pa ston pa'i gzhung ma yin na/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa nyams su len tshul ston pa'i mngon pa gong 'og gnyis nang rig pa ston pa'i gzhung yin par bud/ gal te rnam 'grel gyi bden bzhi'i rnam pa nyams su len pa'i ston gzhung de nang rig pa ston pa'i gzhung ma yin na/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa nyams su len pa'i lam de thar lam kyang ma yin par 'gyur ba'i phyir nges 'byung sgom pa dang 'khor ba las grol ba'i ched du bden bzhi'i rnam pa mi rtag sogs bcu drug nyams su len tshul phar phyin sogs theg pa che chung gi mdo bstan bcos du ma las bshad pa rnams kyang khyod kyis 'gog par gyis shig dang brjod par bya'o/

/mdor na tshad ma'i gzhung de dag nang rig pa ston pa'i gzhung yin de/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa rigs pa'i sgo nas gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lo tsā ba 'dis sngar de ltar dgag pa mdzad kyang*/ phyis rje la dad pa thob nas bstod pa phul ba'i tshul gong du drangs pa'i lung de'i 'phror/ byang phyogs 'di na tshig la mkhas pa nyung*/ don la sgro 'dogs chod pa de bas dkon/ /bstan don nyams su len pa srid mtha' tsam/ /de gsum mthar phyin khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsung rab mtha' dag khyad par rdo rje theg /rgyud sde mtha' dag khyad par 'dus pa dang*/ /rim gnyis mtha' dag khyad par sgyu lus la/ /sngon med legs bshad gter chen khyod la 'dud/ ces bstod pa phul lo/ /sgron me'i 'od kyis gzugs gsal yang*/ /lkog gyur gzugs rnams min pa lta/ /mang thos mkhas khyod rnam 'grel gyi/ /gzhung don zab la kun du 'khor/ /gal te sngon ma'i lugs srol 'dzin phyir tsam/ /skyon med pa la skyon gyis sgro 'dogs na/ /mi gtsang pha mes phor ba gtsang 'dzin bzhin/ /gzur gnas mkhas pa'i tshul min smyon pa'i gar/ /mkhas pa'i stag khyod tha snyad nags tshal du/ bder gnas legs kyi tshad gzhung brag ngos su/ / rgyu byas 'khrul ba'i g.yang gsar lhung ba la/ /gzhan gyi rigs pa'i mdung thung bsnun nas 'gum/ /sngon tshe bod kyi mkhas pa su yis kyang*/ /sngon tshe ma rtogs rigs pa'i gzhung gi don/ /ji bzhin gzigs nas gdams par legs shar zhing*/ /ji bzhin ston pa rje las gzhan na gang*/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ byams pa'i gzhung gdams par shar tshul dang*/ klu sgrub kyi gzhung gdams par shar tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de nas byang sa mdo sde rgyan gnyis po/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ tshad ma'i gzhung gdams par shar ba'i tshul bshad pa de nas 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa tshig sdud kyis byang sar grags pa dang*/

byams mgon gyis mdzad pa'i mdo sde rgyan gnyis po brjod bya ston tshul phan tshun legs par sbyar te tshul bzhin rab tu 'bad cing dpyad pas mi pham chos rje'i gzhung mdo sde'i rgyan sogs dang*/ de'i rjes 'brang thogs med sku mched sogs kyi gzhung kun nyams su len pa'i gdams par shar ro/ /spyir sa sde lnga dang sdom rnam gnyis sogs mdzad kyang*/ byang sa 'di mdo sde rgyan gyi don 'grel yin zhing*/ rgyal bas byang sems kyi bslab bya'i rab dbye mtha' yas zhig gsungs kyang/ bsdu na phyin drug tu 'du bar bshad pa ltar mdo sde rgyan las kyang byang sems kyi bslab bya rnams phyin drug tu 'du ba'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas legs par bshad la/ byang sa las kyang de'i don ji lta ba bzhin 'chad cing*/ rje nyid kyis lam rim che chung sogs las kyang de bzhin du 'chad pa mdzad do/ /byang sa 'di la rgya 'grel 'ga' re 'dug kyang mdo sde rgyan dang sbyor tshul de tsam du mi gsal zhing*/ rje nyid kyis de gnyis sbyor tshul rgyas par legs par bshad pa'i srol 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros kyi gsung las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /mdo sde rgyan gyi lta ba'i rnam gzhag sems tsam pa'i lugs yin kyang*/ bslab bya phyin drug sogs kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa thams cad ni dbu sems gnyis ka thun mong ba yin pa ltar/ byang sa yang de ltar ro/ /rgyal tshab dam pa mi pham mgon nyid kyis/ /rgyal gsung mdo sde'i mtsho las phyin drug sogs/ /rgyal sras bslab bya rin chen mang gsungs pa/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin legs par blangs/ /thogs med sku mched bla ma rjes/ /rgyal tshab gsung rab rin chen nor/ /legs bshad rgyal mtshan rtser mchod de/ /thar 'dod gdul bya'i re skong mdzad/ /gnyis pa ni/ lhag par zab cing rgya che'i gsung rab tshogs/ /zhes sogs rkang pa lnga ste/ gong du bshad pa der ma zad/ lhag par du yang zab cing rgya che ba'i thub pa'i gsung rab kyi tshogs lung drangs nas bsgrigs pa'i go rim mdzad pa nyid las lam gyi rim pa'i gnad kun la nges pa ster nus pa slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i bslab pa kun las btus pa la brten nas/

'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i mdo sde kun las btus pa dang*/ bstod tshogs dang*/ rin chen 'phreng ba la sogs pa klu sgrub lugs kyi gzhung gi mchog du ma'i don rnams nyams su len pa'i rim pa legs par mthong ngo*/ /bslab btus 'di ni mdo kun las btus pa'i don 'grel du bshad cing*/ 'dis mdo lung du ma drangs nas bsgrigs tshul ni/ thog mar dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshul dang*/ tshe 'dir snying po len pa'i bsam pa dang*/ dad pa'i khyad par dang*/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed pa dang*/ de nas lus longs spyod dge rtsa gsum la gtong ba dang srung ba dang dag pa dang spel ba'i tshul bzhi bzhi byed tshul gsungs pa 'dis mdo kun las btus bshad par bya'o zhes rjes dgongs pa rab gsal du gsungs la/ de bzhin du mdo kun btus las bstan pa la dad pa brnyed dka' ba dang sems bskyed dka' ba dang*/ sems can la snying rje brnyed dka' zhing*/ las sgrib dang bdud las dang chos spong sogs spong brnyed dka' tshul gsungs pa rnams ni byang sems kyi bslab bya'i sdom mo/ /klu sgrub lugs kyi zhes pa'i zla grags la sogs pa klu sgrub kyi lugs 'dzin pa'i gzhung rnams kyi don yang gdams ngag tu shar bar bzung ngo*/ /blo gsal thar 'dod rnams kyi mgon/ /mgon po'i gzhung gi brjod don kun/ /kun nas nyams su len pa'i tshul/ /tshul bzhin gdams par khyod la shar/ /'phags yul mkhas grub yongs kyi gsung rab dang*/ /khyad par klu sgrub yab sras nas brgyud pa'i/ /gzhung lugs kun kyang khyod nyid 'ba' zhig la/ /gdams pa'i mchog tu shar gyi gzhan la min/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ /bya spyod kyi rgyud gnyis gdams par shar tshul/ rnal 'byor rgyud gdams par shar tshul/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gdams par shar tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de nas bsam gtan phyi ma rnam snang gi /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ de nas gong du bshad pa ltar bsam gtan phyi ma sogs bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi dang bye brag gi rgyud rnams dang*/

ngo bo spyod rgyud yin yang bya spyod gnyis kyi nyams len thun mong du 'chad pa'i rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa'i don/ paṇa chen sangs rgyas gsang ba yis bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel par nyams len dang sbyar te legs par bshad pa la brten nas/ bya spyod kyi rgyud gnyis kyi lam gyi gnad kun legs par gdams par shar ro/ /de ltar shar ba'i tshul sngags rim nas 'byung ba ltar te 'dir mang du dogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpal ldan de nyid bsdus pa'i lam gyi gnad/ /ces sogs rkang pa brgyad de/ rnal 'byor rgyud las rtsa ba'i rgyud dpal ldan de nyid bsdus pa'i lam gyi gnad rnams dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchogalas rgyal mchog gi ting 'dzin gsum gyis bsdus par mthong bar cung zad sla yang*/ lam der zab mo'i don sgom tshul bshad par rtogs par dka' ba ni paṇa chen sangs rgyas gsang bas rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud cha mthun gyi rgyud rnam pa gsum sbyar te nyams su len pa'i rim par tshul bzhin du bshad dang*/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi zab mo'i nyams len sgom pa'i rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du bshad pas blo mun bsal lo/ /rkang pa phyi ma 'di sngon ma rnams dang sbrel te bshad na sangs rgyas gsang bas rje sogs gzhan gyi blo mun bsal ba dang sbyor yang*/ don la rje rang nyid kyis kyang de ltar mkhyen te nyams su len tshul rnams sngags rim du bkod nas gdul bya'i blo mun bsal bar ston par sems te/ rje rang nyid la rgyud sde de rnams gdams par shar bar 'chad pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir ro/ / blo bzang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar tsam gyis/ /rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /legs phye thar 'dod bung ba'i tshogs rnams la/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston sbyin par mdzad/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ 'dus pa'i skor gdams par shar tshul dang*/ de la brten nas gzhan mang po gdams par shar tshul lo/

/dang po ni/ thub pa'i legs bshad kun gyi mthar thug pa/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad bzhi ste/ thub pa'i dbang po'i legs bshad mdo sngags kyi gsung rab kun gyi nang nas brjod bya'i dbang du byas pa'i mthar thug pa dpal ldan rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams yin la/ de yi nang na shin tu ches zab pa ni dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po ste/ rgyud de la smra ba'i dam pa 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs 'di skad du gsung ngo*/ /ji ltar na 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud lam gyi gnad rnams ni/ drang nges gnyis/ dgongs dgongs min gnyis/ sgra ji bzhin pa yin min gnyis te mtha' drug dang*/ yig don/ spyi don/ sbas don/ mthar thug ste/ tshul bzhi'i rgyas btab ste gnas pa'i tshul rnams rang stobs kyis rtogs dka' bas rgyu mtshan de'i phyir bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang bas bla ma'i man ngag las ni tshul de shes par bya bar gsungs so/ /de ltar gsungs pa'i tshul de gnad kyi don du bzung nas bla ma'i man ngag gi mthar thug pa klu sgrub kyi mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ 'phags pa lha'i spyod bsdus/ klu byang gi rnam gzhag rim pa sogs 'dus pa'i dgongs 'grel 'phags pa'i skor gyi gzhung phran bu la sngar ring du 'dris par byas te/ de nas rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi don sgron me lta bur gsal bar byed pa zla ba grags pa'i sgron gsal la brten nas/ rgyud phyi ma/ rdo rje 'phreng ba/ dgongs pa lung ston/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ lha mo bzhis zhus te 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud chen po lnga dang rtsa rgyud legs par sbyar ba'i tshul la 'bad pa chen pos ring du sbyangs so/ /sbyor ba'i gzhung dngos ni sgron gsal mchan bu mtha' gcod dang bcas pa yin la/ sngags rim/ rim lnga gsal sgron/ rnam gzhag rim pa sogs kyang sbyar ba mang ngo*/ /sbyor tshul ni/ bshad rgyud kyi gzhung de dang de'i rtsa rgyud kyi gzhung gi rim gnyis kyi skor 'di dang 'di tshul 'di ltar du 'chad ces sbyar ba'o/

/dpal ldan rgyud sde stong phrag so gsum dang*/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad kyi/ /gnad kun tshang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i rdo rje'i rgya yi bcings/ /tshul de mkhas grub gzhan dag gi /mkhyen pa'i 'od kyis ma dgrol yang*/ /dpal ldan zla ba bla ma rje'i/ /rnam dpyod sor rtses rnam par bkrol/ /gnyis pa ni/ de yi mthu las bde dgyes dus 'khor sogs/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ 'dus pa'i skor thams cad gdams par shar ba de yi mthu las bde mchog dang*/ dgyes rdor dang*/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud la sogs pa rgyud sde gzhan mang po'i gnad don rnams gdams par shar la/ tshul de dag bdag gis sngags rim chen mo dang*/ bde mchog rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang*/ / mngon rtogs kyi 'grel ba sogs gzhan du bshad pas na de dag tu shes par bya la/ skabs 'dir ni rnam dpyod can dag la sgo tsam zhig bstan pa'o/ /dus 'khor la rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung phran 'ga' re 'dug kyang*/ rje'i bshad srol ltar mkhas grub chos rjes dus 'khor ṭika chen mdzad pa ni grags che'o/ /mang mang mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i chu klung kun/ /mkhas mkhas yongs kyi rjer gyur btsong kha ba'i/ /zab zab mkhyen pa rgya mtsho'i grwa gcig na/ /nges nges dogs pa med par rgyu 'di mtshar/ /gang gi mkhyen rabs sor 'phrul gyis/ /gsang chen rgyud mangs nyer bsgrags tshe/ gsang bdag in+d+ra bo dhi des/ /ma bzod o ḍa'i yul du gshegs/ skabs bsdu ba ni/ bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar ba'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //༈ gsum pa la gnyis/ nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs pa dang*/ dge ba kun bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de ltar gdams pa'i gter du gyur pa na/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ ji skad bshad pa'i tshul de ltar gzhung lugs thams cad nyams su len pa'i gdams par shar ba'i gdams ngag gi gter du gyur pa na/

mdo sngags kyi theg pa chen po gnyis kyi thun mong ba'i lam dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rim pa gnyis kyi gnad bsdus tshang ba'i lam gyi nyams len la ring du 'dris pa ste goms par byas pa'i tshul gyis legs par sbyangs so/ /de yang theg chen thun mong pa mdo phyogs kyi lam gyi gnad bsdus pa ni/ sems bskyed nas sbyor ba phyin drug la slob pa nyid yin zhing*/ phyin drug gi nang du skabs gsum dang*/ tshul khrims rnam pa gsum dang*/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi nyams len yang 'du ste/ bslab pa gsum gyi tshul khrims ni de'i tshul khrims dang*/ bsam gtan dang shes rab ni de'i phyi ma gnyis su 'du'o/ /sdom pa gzhan dang tshul khrims rnam pa gsum ka'ang de'i tshul khrims su 'du zhing*/ lam gtso bo'i nges 'byung gi skor yang tshul khrims dang*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ni shes rab tu 'du la/ sems bskyed ni rgyal sras kyi bslab pa kun gyi gzhi dang rten no/ /de ltar sems bskyed bas phyin drug la slob pa'i steng du sngags kyi rim gnyis kyi nyams len mdzad pa ni mdo sngags kyi gnad bsdus tshang ba'i lam la 'dris pa'o/ /der ma zad sngags kyi zab gsal gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor ram bla med kyi lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po'i ye shes khyad par can gcig po la'ang mdo sngags kyi lam gyi gnad tshang bar bshad pa yod de ma bris so/ /chos kyi tshul kun kun nas thugs chud do/ / bsgoms pas de don don bzhin nyams blangs nas/ /go 'phang mchog brnyes brnyes pa'i tshul de ltar/ /gzhan la legs ston ston pa gnyis pa khyod/ /rje btsun khyod kyis mdo sngags kyi/ snying po nyams len bdud rtsi kun/ /gsol bas rjes 'brang bdag cag la/ /nyams len bdud rtsi 'ga' ma lus/ /snyigs dus gdul bya'i zhing sa mi gshin la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i sa bon btab byas kyang*/ /las nyon than pas gdung bas mdo sngags kyi/

/sa lam myu gu 'khrungs dka' dus kyi dbang*/ /'on te gzhung lugs rgya mtsho cher/ /zhugs nas cha tsam 'thung bas kyang*/ /nyes pa'i dri skom sbyangs byas nas/ /mngon mtho nges legs bde ba ster/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyal sras smon lam gad+gā'i klung rnams ni/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi 'dun legs dang bcas pa ste/ rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gad+gā'i klung ste rgya mtsho'am/ chu bo'i gad+gā'i chu'i phung po ltar mang ba rnams ni/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin par smon pa'i smon lam btab pa'i nang du 'dus kyis 'dus par rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo lha mo dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las rgyal bas gsungs pa'i phyir blo bzang grags pa'i dpal bdag gis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa dang*/ khyad par du tshe 'dir thos sogs byas pa'i dge ba kun kyang thub pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngo'o/ /lha mo dpal phreng gi mdo las gsungs pa de/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas bslab btus su drangs shing*/ de ru dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i tshul spyi dang bye brag 'chad pa'i mdo gzhan 'ga' zhig kyang drangs 'dug pa rnams 'dir bkod na mang du dogs pas dgongs pa mtshon tsam zhig blangs te brjod na/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa ni/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa dang gnad gcig cing*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa la tshul gnyis te/ thabs gzhan gyis 'dzin pa dang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas 'dzin tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgyal po lta bus stobs kyis chos min gyi phyogs tshar bcad nas chos kyi phyogs rgyas par byed pa ni stobs kyis 'dzin pa dang*/ phyogs glang chos grags lta bus rigs pa'i sgo nas chos min tshar bcad de chos dar bar mdzad pa lta bu rigs pa'i sgo nas 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dam pa'i chos spyi dang bye brag theg chen gyi chos thos bsam bsgoms pa'i sgo nas 'dzin pa dang*/ bka' sde snod dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas 'dzin pa dang*/

mdo sngags kyi don gyi snying po nyams len gyi sgo nas 'dzin pa ste/ de rnams kyang dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'o/ /yang dam chos 'dzin pa la phyogs re tsam 'dzin pa dang*/ yongs su rdzogs par 'dzin pa gnyis so/ /phyogs re tsam la nges pa med de/ mdo'i phyogs re dang*/ sngags kyi phyogs re 'dzin pa dang*/ de la'ang lung gi phyogs dang*/ rtogs pa'i phyogs re'o/ /yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa la mdo phyogs yongs rdzogs dang sngags phyogs yongs rdzogs gnyis kyi dang po ni thogs med sku mched sogs kyis 'dzin tshul lta bu dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ in+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ sa ra has 'dzin tshul lta bu yin la/ mdo sngags gnyis ka yongs su rdzogs par 'dzin tshul ni/ mgon po klu sgrub yab sras dang*/ rje bla ma yab sras kyis 'dzin tshul lta bu'o/ /'o na/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos pas dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i ched du bsngos par 'gro yang*/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du bsngos pa'i go chos dang*/ mi chod/ mi chod na mi 'thad par rtogs sla la/ chod na de'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ bden te/ bstan pa rgyas pa dang dam pa'i chos thams cad 'dzin par sems bskyed cing smon pa ni/ sems can thams cad phan bde la 'god pa'i ched dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi dam pa'i chos thams cad sgrub par sems bskyed cing smon pa yin pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du yang bsngos par 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /spyir dge ba rnams sangs rgyas thob pa dang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos pa la phan yon dpag tu med pa yod tshul yum gyi mdo'i bsngo ba sgom lam 'chad pa'i skabs sogs mdo bstan bcos du ma las gsungs shing*/ khyad par stong nyid lta bas zin pa'i sgo nas rdzogs byang du bsngos na lhag par phan yon che zhing*/

bden 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i dge ba kun zil gyis gnon nus pa yin te/ sdud pa las/ de ltar bsod nams byang chub yongs su sngo byed na/ /dug med sangs rgyas mi spong rgyal bas gsungs pa smra/ /de ltar bsngos pas dpa' bo 'jig rten dmigs can gyi/ /byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ bzang spyod las/ dus gsum shegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*/ /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang de lta bu la dgongs so/ /bsngo smon gyi khyad par ni/ bsngo rgyu'i rdzas dang ldan pa'i sgo nas de dang de'i rgyu smon pa ni bsngo smon gnyis ka yin la/ bsngo rgyu'i rdzas yod pa la ma bltos pa'i smon pa ni smon lam tsam mo/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi lcags srang stong*/ /gser gyi gong bur bsgyur pa ltar/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched bsngos pa'i/ /dge kun sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /bzang bzang gzhan don mdzad bzhed skyes chen gyis/ /bsags bsags rnam dkar bstan 'gro byang chub ched/ /mang mang gzhan dag dge ba bgyis phal cher/ /yang yang 'khor ba 'grub pa'i ched bsngos 'khrul/ /'dun legs kyi don ni/ sngar ltar la/ skabs bsdu ba ni/ tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs pa dang*/ kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /rje btsun khyod kyis nyin mtshan kun tu yang*/ /thugs dam zab mo'i nyams len tshul la 'bad/ /rjes 'brang bdag cag nyin mo brel g.yeng dang*/ /mtshan du gti mug rnal 'byor sgom la brtson/ /༈ gzhi pa la gsum/ dgos pa dang*/ smon lam dang*/ mdzad byang ngo*/ / dang po ni/ rang gi dge ba rgya chen spel phyir dang*/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ste/ ji skad bshad pa ltar/ rtogs pa brjod pa'i dgos pa gang zhe na/ rang gis sngar byas pa'i dge ba rnams rgya cher gong du spel bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/

rjes 'jug rnam dpyod ldan pa'i gdul bya skal bzang mang po bstan pa la thos bsam sgom pa'i 'jug sgo ma nor ba 'di ltar bya'o zhes don de tshul bzhin legs par bstan pa'i phyir du rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i bstan bcos 'di byas so/ / gnyis pa ni/ de las thob pa'i dge ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /zhes sogs rkang ba bzhi ste/ rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa brtsams pa de las thob pa'i dge ba'i tshogs rnams kyi mthus/ ji skad bshad pa'i rtogs brjod nas 'byung ba'i rim pa 'di yi sgo nas 'gro ba ma lus pa kun kyang thub pa'i rtul zhugs te cha lugs sam mdzad spyod bla na med pa bzung nas rgyal ba dgyes pa'i theg chen gyi lam la 'jug par shog cig ces pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ces rang gi rtogs pa mngon par brjod pa mdo tsam du bshad pa 'di ni/ mang du thos pa'i dge slong shar btsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis 'brog ri bo che dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni dka' bzhi pa rin chen dpal lo/ /zhes byung ba ni go sla la/ 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che phyogs kun tu rgyas par byed nus par gyur cig ces pa ni zhar byung ngam/ gzhan gyis bcug pa'o// //༈ swa sti/ sku gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo dngos/ /dpal ldan rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje'i 'chang*/ /gang de bshes gnyen gar gyis rnal rol ba/ /rgyal ba gnyis par grags pa de la 'dud/ /khyod kyi thugs gsang rgya mtsho las 'ongs pa'i/ /gzhung mang thos pas rna ba'i lam byang zhing*/ /snying bum legs bshad bdud rtsi'i chus gang bas/ /kha nas khyod kyi bstod bsngags cud zad bsgrags/ /blo chen gzhan gyis shin tu dpag dka' ba'i/ /bzang po'i mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' mi mngon nang*/ /legs bshad rin chen bye bas yongs gang zhing*/ /'phrin las grags pa'i rlabs 'phreng ches cher g.yo/ /mnyam med mkhyen brtse'i rkang stegs kyis/

/mkhas mchog kun gyi mgo bo la/ /ngal gso mdzad pas phyogs kun las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /thub pa'i nyi ma nub ri'i rtser/ /son nas mun pa'i gos gyon pa/ /de tshe smra ba'i zla ba khyod/ /shar gyi sa 'dzin rtse nas thon/ /khyod kyis zab don gzigs pa'i dper/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mkhyen pa btsal/ /de nas de gnyis dbyer med pa/ /mthong bas bdag cag dpe yi dbul/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i don 'byed par/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen nyid/ /de nyid dbye bar ma nus pas/ / bdag cag mi smra'i brtul zhugs blangs/ snyigs dus 'gro ba'i tshul gzigs nas/ /rgyal ba nyid kyang rang bstan la/ /btang snyoms mdzad dus mgon khyod kyis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa ma lus bzung*/ /de slad chos kun gzigs pa la/ /rgyal ba nyid dang dbyer med kyang*/ /thugs rjes rgyal ba'ang skyengs mdzad pas/ /rgyal ba nyid las lhag gam snyam/ /dus 'dir thub dbang dngos byon yang*/ /gdul bar mi sbyor ltar gyur tshe/ /khyod kyis thub pa'i dam chos kun/ /bzung nas rgyal ba'i 'phrin las bsgrubs/ /rgyal bas cod pan ma pham dbur/ /bcings nas rang gi rgyal tshab tu/ /dbang bskur de bzhin byams pas kyang*/ /cod pan khyod la 'ching bar rigs/ /khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho las/ /chu thig tsam zhig rnam dpyod kyi/ /ku shu'i rtser blangs khyod mchod kyis/ /rdzogs par kun mkhyen gyis kyang min/ /rje btsun bla ma'i gsung rab rgya mtsho las/ /legs 'khrungs rtogs brjod dbang po'i 'dab rgya'i tshal/ /dgongs don gsal byed mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur pa/ /snang byed nyi ma'i 'od zer deng nas shar/ /dge des rgyal ba'i dgongs zab zab don ji bzhin rab gzigs gzigs ltar gdul bya gzhan dag la/ ji bzhin gsal bar legs ston ston pa gnyis pa chos rje rje btsun bla ma btsong kha pas/ /skye kun 'bral med rab brtse brtse ba chen pos rjes 'dzin 'dzin ma'i khyon dang phyogs kun tu/

/mgon de'i mdo sngags chos tshul tshul bzhin bzung nas tshogs rdzogs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni mdo sngags rab 'byams la sbyangs te rje'i gsung rab la rigs pa'i sgo nas dad pa lhag par thob cing*/ snyan ngag gi tshul la mkhyen pa rgyas pa mo ne'i khri zur sangs rgyas dpal bzang nas/ rtogs brjod 'di rje'i rnam mthar gyi gtso bor snang bas 'di'i 'grel pa snyan ngag gis brgyan pa zhig gyis dang*/ kho bos par du bsgrub par bya'o zhes gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ sgrub pa nyams len gyi sgo nas rje mnyes par byed ma nus kyang*/ dgongs pa bkral ba dang*/ gsol ba btab pa'i mthus rje nyid kyis brtse bas cung zad tsam zhig bzung ba yin nam snyam pa'i rmi ltas lan 'ga' re mthong bar rlom pa/ g.yo sa'i khri zur du grags pa shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub kyis/ gzhung 'di'i 'grel pa sngon ma mthong yang rang blos gang dpog gis/ rje'i rnam mthar spyi 'gro bsdus pa zhig sngon du btang ba'i rtogs brjod kyi 'grel pa 'phros dang bcas pa 'di co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ro// //maṅga laṃ// //

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/rje rin po che'irnam thar dang 'brel ba'i rtogs brjod kyi 'grel pa dgongs pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 314--PAGE 313--PAGE 264-
